title: Ethical Alternatives to Kaggle [D]
summary: I personally find it unconscionable to mandate biometric verification - with a controversial vendor on the top of that - to access a competition. Not to cash a prize, just to submit a solution. What are alternatives competition to have fun with SOTA or quasi-SOTA models? submitte
reason: Reddit discussion asking for alternatives to Kaggle over biometric verification requirements. No named model release, no research artifact, no industry business event, no policy action, and no OSS tool/framework announcement.
